legend.blueprint: Static values in firm_blueprints before randomize_trade_config runs.
legend.randomization: What randomize_trade_config may change at order time.
legend.runtime_note: Many firms also adjust SL via calculate_funded_sl, calculate_adjusted_sl_midnight, or TMDL cap after randomization.

runtime_sl_adjustments.calculate_funded_sl: Funded trade 2+: SL$ = balance - lock_level; trade 1 often fixed $2k risk (see app path).
runtime_sl_adjustments.calculate_adjusted_sl_midnight: Challenge/intraday: widen/tighten SL from SOD balance vs blueprint SL dollars.
runtime_sl_adjustments.calculate_adjusted_sl_tmdl_cap: Cap SL to remaining trailing drawdown before lock.
